Signal reference

SignalMeaning
paste Clipboard paste into the response field (hard signal).
copy Clipboard copy from the page (soft signal).
drop Drag-and-drop into the response field (hard signal).
tab-away ≥10s Left the page for ≥10 seconds; counts toward soft score.
tab-away (mid) Longer than the participant's tab-away threshold (3s by default, 5s strict) and under 10s; counts toward soft score.
flicker At or below the tab-away threshold (3s by default); reported but not scored.
sidebar event Viewport width shrank suddenly — likely AI sidebar opened.
AI extension Browser extension known for AI assistance detected.
kb shortcut DevTools-adjacent keyboard shortcut used.
viewport shift Viewport width changed substantially (recorded as "layout shift" before 0.6.1).
zoom change Browser zoom level changed.
synthetic insertionText appeared without matching keystrokes.
foreign input Keystroke outside the response field.
typing/keystroke In the replay viewer only: keys pressed during the recording, shown as chips while the trial plays back. Not scored; a viewer aid, not a signal.
edge exit Mouse exited the viewport edge — pattern often seen with sidebar use.
×

Score weights

Points per event: a participant's score is the sum, over the signals, of points × events (up to the cap). A weight of 0 leaves a signal out. Hard at moves anyone with that many events or more into the hard tier, shown as HARD*. The list re-scores and re-sorts as you change them. This report's files keep the weights it was built with; Copy config gives the lines for cyborg-hunter.config.json, so the next CLI run builds the same list.
